title: Two Complete Sets Compatible with Momcozy M5 Breast Pump Replacement Parts, 24mm Collection Cup and 15/17/19/21mm 8pcs Flange Size Kit for M5 only, not Other Models
bullets: Two Full Set Milk Collector Cups: Compatible with momcozy m5 replacement parts including 15/17/19/21mm*8pcs breast pump flange insert (2pcs per each size),duckbill valves*2pcs,silicone diaphragm*2pcs, 24mm Double-Sealed Flange*2pcs and milk collector cup*2pcs.providing a perfect fit and a comfortable pumping experience with precise sizing, essential maintenance components, double-sealed leak-proof flanges, soft silicone for reduced friction, and two full sets for convenient backups or on-the-go use.

Two Full Set Milk Collector Cups: Compatible with momcozy m5 replacement parts including 15/17/19/21mm*8pcs breast pump flange insert (2pcs per each size),duckbill valves*2pcs,silicone diaphragm*2pcs, 24mm Double-Sealed Flange*2pcs and milk collector cup*2pcs.providing a perfect fit and a comfortable pumping experience with precise sizing, essential maintenance components, double-sealed leak-proof flanges, soft silicone for reduced friction, and two full sets for convenient backups or on-the-go use.

Compatibility: This full milk collection cups replacement kit is only compatible with the Momcozy M5 wearable breast pump – it won’t work with other models. Important: these are not original Momcozy accessories; they’re high-quality replacement parts made by APMOOM, designed for a perfect fit and reliable performance with your pump.

Premium Materials: Crafted from food-grade silicone, these replacement pump parts are durable, leak-proof, BPA-free, and naturally soft with no odor. They’re gentle on mommy’s skin and safe for baby, ensuring peace of mind during every use.

Easy to Clean: After each use, wash the duckbill valves and diaphragm (compatible with Momcozy M5) with warm soapy water and rinse thoroughly. For deep cleaning, sterilize them in boiling water or steam at ≤100°C (212°F) for 5–10 minutes. Avoid using hard brushes—simply use your fingertips to gently scrub instead.

Increased Efficiency: The M5 wearable breast pump milk collector set is designed to boost your pumping efficiency. The silicone diaphragm’s anti-backflow design prevents milk from flowing backward, ensuring clean, long-lasting use—no contamination. Meanwhile, the duckbill valve’s anti-overflow design ensures milk flows downward only, keeping the collection process mess-free and hygienic.
